stories.title: Explainability Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to normalize raw evaluation signals from provider credentials, external links, and clinical trials into the standardized explainability schema (populate source, meaning, limitations consistently across signal types).

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Content
stories.description: Update chat UI message rendering to display explainability content (source, meaning, limitations) in a readable format within MessageBubble without breaking existing markdown rendering or sanitization.

stories.title: Graceful Handling of Missing Explainability Fields
stories.description: Ensure system gracefully handles partial or missing explainability data by applying defaults or fallbacks, preventing malformed responses or UI breakage.

stories.title: Tool Router Compatibility with Explainability Objects
stories.description: Ensure tool_router correctly passes through explainability-enhanced responses without validation errors and maintains compatibility with existing tool schemas and chat history injection.
